planted.heading: Prices and Payment
planted.note: Prices changeable at any time with no notice, applying even to confirmed orders.

planted.heading: Delivery and Risk
planted.note: Risk moves to the Client when goods leave the warehouse, so the Client pays for transit damage.

planted.heading: Indemnity
planted.note: Indemnity reversed: the Client covers the Vendor's losses, even those caused by the Vendor's own negligence.

planted.heading: Data Protection
planted.note: Any sub-processor in any country may handle personal data, with no notice or consent.

planted.heading: Notices
planted.note: Email notices are void; registered post is the only valid channel.
